description: Draw a polar grid (Polar Grid tool, with its options dialog) as a group: concentric ellipses and radial lines, each with skew. compoundPath makes every other ring a compound path (Create Compound Path From Ellipses). With fill, the ellipses are filled (Fill Grid)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

compoundPath.description: Create Compound Path From Ellipses: pair the ellipses from the outside in as compound paths, so alternate rings are filled. Default false

concentricDividers.description: Number of ellipses inside the outer one. Default 5

concentricSkew.description: Skew, -500 to 500 percent. 0 spaces the dividers evenly; positive crowds them toward the outside, negative toward the inside, each gap being (1 + |skew|/100) times its neighbour. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

radialDividers.description: Number of lines from the centre to the edge. The first points to 12 o'clock. Default 5

radialSkew.description: Skew, -500 to 500 percent. 0 spaces the lines evenly. Going counterclockwise from 12 o'clock, positive makes each sector 1 + |skew|/100 times smaller than the one before, negative that much larger. Default 0

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

x.description: Left edge of the grid, points from the artboard's left

y.description: Top edge of the grid, points from the artboard's top

name: create_polar_grid
title: Create Polar Grid
